title: Attachments
description: Where each muscle starts (origin) and ends (insertion). One row per end. pipeline/data/src/validate.ts checks that muscle names a muscle and bone names a bone.

landmark.description: The spot on the bone in plain words, for example greater trochanter.

says_kind.description: quote when says is the source's own words (only for licences compatible with CC BY 4.0), summary when it is our own short summary.

checked_by.description: Null until a person has checked the row against its sources. Then owner or a physio role label such as physio-1, never a name.

checked_on.description: The date the row was checked, like 2026-11-03. Required when checked_by is set, see validate.ts.
